_comment: Bead enrollment batch 2 — fermat (crew-18), 2026-08-16T14:2xZ. Base: FLT main 0ffa532.
Requested by Fable 14:15Z: keep the refinement feed stocked so the pool does not starve
the moment C1+C2 close hub-r7qdn.7.
Batch 1 (enrollment/wave-3-and-endgame.json) carried the 11 packets dispatchable with no
prerequisites at all. These 10 are the next layer: nine Odlyzko-endgame nodes that are
dispatchable because they are HYPOTHESIS-PARAMETRIZED — each states its prerequisite as an
explicit argument rather than waiting for it — plus a corrected acceptance record for the
already-existing bead hub-oig35.3.
*** ENROLL IN PRIORITY BATCHES, NOT ALL AT ONCE. ***
The pilot recorded at 14:07Z that the packet-refiner has a robustness defect:
run_refinement_feed records skipped-invalid and then re-raises _InvalidRefinementCandidate,
failing the ENTIRE bounded pass instead of continuing to other candidates — which is what
the malformed hub-oig35.19 candidate did to it. Until that is fixed, ONE malformed record
of mine takes the whole feed down. So: create the three p0 records from batch 1 first,
confirm a clean refiner pass, then the p1s, then this batch. I have validated every record
here for non-null description/acceptance_criteria and for metadata state/lane/wave, but
validation on my side is not the same as the feed accepting it.
DELTA CONVENTION for the hypothesis-parametrized nodes: state the prerequisite as an
explicit hypothesis argument, NOT as a sorry. A fully-proved node is then delta [0,0] and
the count gate acts as a tripwire — any nonzero delta means a hole was left in.
NOT ENROLLED, deliberately: endgame T2 (delete the axiom) — it cannot pass until M1-M11 are
all discharged, and it needs a special gate (#print axioms, not the sorry count, since
removing an axiom does not move the count). Also Q3', R3 and R4-R7: gated on PQ1, the
unfetched Poitou artifact. See cartography/odlyzko-endgame-decomposition.md §7.

beads.title: P3: zero side of the explicit formula is nonnegative on the critical line
beads.description: For a zero rho = 1/2 + i*gamma of the completed zeta with gamma real, show that the explicit formula's zero-side contribution Phi_F(rho) equals Fhat(gamma) and is therefore nonnegative, given the hypothesis Fhat >= 0. State Fhat >= 0 as an explicit hypothesis argument (node ENDGAME-Q1 supplies it for autocorrelations). This is the easy half of the zero-side discard and, importantly, it is NOT where GRH would have been used — that is node P4. Depends on ENDGAME-P1 for the shape of the formula; if P1 has not landed, restate its conclusion as a local hypothesis. See cartography/odlyzko-endgame-decomposition.md §2.

beads.title: P4: zero side is nonnegative OFF the critical line — the GRH-free step
beads.description: The node that makes the whole Odlyzko method unconditional. For a zero rho = beta + i*gamma with beta not equal to 1/2, Phi_F(rho) is not literally Fhat of a real number, so P3 does not apply. Pair rho with its functional-equation partner 1 - conj(rho) — both are zeros, by Lambda_K(s) = Lambda_K(1-s) together with Lambda_K(conj s) = conj(Lambda_K(s)) — and show the PAIR contributes nonnegatively. For F even with Fhat >= 0 the pair sum has the shape integral of F(x) * 2*cosh((beta - 1/2)*x) * cos(gamma*x) dx; nonnegativity comes from the Tartar/maximum-principle argument that odlyzko-reconciled.md node M8 describes as 'positivity on the full critical strip'. State 0 <= beta <= 1 as an explicit hypothesis — the zeros lie in the strip by chapter node M3 — and do not attempt a sharper region. THIS IS THE MOST DELICATE NODE IN M8 and the one I expect may exceed size M.

No new axiom keyword. *** HARD CONTRACT, ESCALATE RATHER THAN BREAK IT: this node must NOT acquire a Riemann-Hypothesis or GRH hypothesis. *** If the proof appears to need one, stop and report — a GRH-conditional P4 silently converts the campaign's unconditional target (|discr K| >= 8.25^n, no hypotheses) into a conditional one, which is precisely the weaker destination AINTLIB walks to and precisely what this chapter exists to avoid. A packet that returns 'proved, assuming GRH' is a FAILED packet, not a partial success. Permitted hypotheses are exactly: 0 <= beta <= 1, F even, Fhat >= 0, and F admissible.

beads.title: P5: the discard inequality
beads.description: Assemble M8: from the explicit-formula identity (ENDGAME-P1), the prime-side nonnegativity (ENDGAME-P2) and the zero-side nonnegativity (ENDGAME-P3 and ENDGAME-P4), derive log|d_K| >= n * A_infinity(F) - (pole terms), with the pole contribution written explicitly in terms of Fhat at the points corresponding to s = 0 and s = 1. Sketch: drop the two nonnegative sides from the identity and rearrange. This inequality is what every later endgame node consumes, so its exact shape is a contract — see cartography/odlyzko-endgame-decomposition.md §2. State the prerequisites as explicit hypothesis arguments so the node is provable before P1-P4 land.

beads.title: Q2: the autocorrelation is an admissible test function
beads.description: Show that F = g convolved with g-tilde (node ENDGAME-Q1) satisfies the admissibility hypotheses of the Weil-Poitou explicit formula, for g real, even, compactly supported and Lipschitz. Target the Belabas-Friedman class rather than a narrower one: even (from Q1); the exponentially-weighted bounded-variation and integrability conditions, which follow from compact support plus Lipschitz; the bounded variation of (F(0) - F(x))/x, from F Lipschitz near 0; and the jump-average condition, trivially, since F is continuous. NOTE ON PRIOR ART: AINTLIB's ExplicitFormula/TestFunction.lean carries exactly the two workhorse lemmas this needs — boundedVariationOn_of_deriv_integrable and boundedVariationOn_Ici_of_piecewise_deriv — so if the AINTLIB port lands this node becomes nearly free. It is enrolled anyway because it is provable without the port and is not on the port's critical path.

beads.title: Q4: the scaling family and its Fourier transform
beads.description: For y > 0 define F_y(x) = F(x/y). Prove that its Fourier transform is Fhat_y(t) = y * Fhat(y*t); that nonnegativity of both F and Fhat is preserved by the scaling; and that admissibility is preserved. Sketch: change of variables. Mathlib anchors: the Real.fourierIntegral composition lemmas and MeasureTheory.integral_comp_smul. Small but load-bearing — the entire numerical optimization in chapter node M10 is a search over this y, so the transform law here fixes how y enters every later formula.
beads.acceptance_criteria: lake build exits 0. Comment-aware live sorry count equals 56 (delta [0,0]). Prose count equals 11. Diff confined to the declared file plus FLT.lean. State the scaling convention explicitly in the module docstring — F_y(x) = F(x/y), not F(y*x) — because a reversed convention here inverts the direction of the later optimization and the error would only surface numerically.

beads.title: Q5: Poitou (13) — the scaled inequality and the function L1(y)
beads.description: Feed the scaled family F_y (ENDGAME-Q4) into the discard inequality (ENDGAME-P5) and divide by n to obtain a lower bound on the root discriminant |d_K|^(1/n). Specialize to the totally complex case r1 = 0 — which is what the target axiom assumes — collapsing the archimedean side to a single Gamma-complex-type term. OUTPUT CONTRACT, and this is the whole point of the node: produce a single real-valued function L1 : positive reals -> reals together with the theorem that for n >= 1 and y > 0, log|d_K| / n >= L1(y) - (pole correction)/n. Everything in chapter nodes M10 and M11 is about evaluating this one L1 at one well-chosen y, so its definition is a contract consumed downstream; name it and document it accordingly. See cartography/odlyzko-endgame-decomposition.md §3.

beads.title: S1: fixed-y monotonicity in the degree n
beads.description: At a fixed y0, show the bound L1(y0) - C/n is nondecreasing in n, where C > 0 is the pole-correction constant from ENDGAME-Q5. Sketch: C/n is decreasing in n, so subtracting it is increasing. This is what lets a single numerical evaluation at n = 18 cover every n >= 18. CAVEAT WORTH READING BEFORE STARTING: the claim that the only n-dependence enters as C/n is inherited from odlyzko-reconciled.md and is stated there rather than shown. Q5 is the node that makes it concrete. If the n-dependence turns out to have another shape, this node changes character and must be re-sized — flag it rather than forcing a proof.

State the n = 18 base case as an explicit hypothesis argument — R6 is gated on the unfetched Poitou artifact (PQ1) and this node must not wait for it. Sketch: induction or direct monotonicity from the base case.

beads.title: S3: convert the logarithmic bound to the axiom's exponential form
beads.description: From log|d_K| / n >= log 8.25 (ENDGAME-S2, taken as a hypothesis argument), derive |(discr K : R)| >= 8.25 ^ finrank Q K — the exact form the target axiom states. Mathlib anchors: Real.exp_le_exp, Real.log_le_iff_le_exp, Real.rpow_natCast. WATCH THE POWER: the axiom's 8.25 ^ finrank Q K is a NATURAL power of a real, i.e. Monoid.npow, not Real.rpow. Land on npow, or insert the Real.rpow_natCast bridge explicitly and say which you did. Small node, but it is the last link before the interface (ENDGAME-T1) and a mismatch here is invisible until final assembly.
